Any attribute that has children. Set the array to true if this attribute is made of a list of attributes

Date and time without time zone, such as the BigQuery DATETIME type. The pattern is a date time pattern such as 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', without offset or time zone, or one of SQL_DATE_TIME (a date, a space or a T, and a time whose seconds and fraction are optional), BASIC_ISO_DATE, ISO_LOCAL_DATE, ISO_DATE, ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME, ISO_DATE_TIME, ISO_ORDINAL_DATE or ISO_WEEK_DATE. A date without time is at the start of the day. A value with an offset or a time zone, or out of the years 1 to 9999, is rejected

Time of day without time zone, such as the BigQuery TIME type. The pattern is a time pattern such as 'HH:mm:ss', without offset, or ISO_LOCAL_TIME or ISO_TIME. On Spark, the value is the text HH:mm:ss followed by the microseconds when they are not 0
Sequence of bytes, such as the BigQuery BYTES type. The pattern is the text encoding of the bytes: base64 or hex

pattern.description: Regex used to validate the input field

primitiveType.description:
To what primitive type should this type be mapped.
 This is the memory representation of the type, When saving, this primitive type is mapped to the database specific type. Default: string

zone.description:
Context-specific parsing configuration:
- For double: locale for decimal parsing (e.g., 'fr_FR' for comma as decimal separator)
- For decimal: precision and scale as 'precision,scale' (e.g., '38,9'). Spark holds a precision of 38 at most: a wider decimal, up to the bounds of a BigQuery BIGNUMERIC (scale of at most 38, precision of at most the scale + 38), is loaded by the native BigQuery loader only
- For timestamp: timezone (e.g., 'UTC', 'Europe/Paris')

sample.description: This field makes sure that the pattern matches the value you want to match. This will be checked on startup

ddlMapping.description: Configure here the type mapping for each datawarehouse.\nWill be used when inferring DDL from schema.
